crossRefs.note: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but Yahweh tests the hearts.
I will turn my hand on you, thoroughly purge away your dross, and will take away all your tin.
and he will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver, and he will purify the sons of Levi, and refine them as gold and…
Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for…

that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes even though it is tested by fire, may be…

translations.web: Take away the dross from the silver, and material comes out for the refiner;
translations.bsb: Remove the dross from the silver, and a vessel for a silversmith will come forth.
translations.kjv: Take away the dross from the silver, and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer.
translations.asv: Take away the dross from the silver, And there cometh forth a vessel for the refiner:
